scientific_integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from standard discrete Morse, Hurewicz and Whitehead theorems; finite tests are corroboration, not proof of arbitrary parameters.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts and thresholds t>=5. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed. Full text of the closest 19-page preprint was not accessible; originality remains subject to that comparison and unindexed literature.
title: Uniform sphere-wedge homotopy types for multipartite path-free complexes
